The Hexham Races

This is a common tune in Northumberland as well as in Scotland, but it’s usually played in G and goes by a different name.
I think it’s a nice little tune. The following setting is from the playing of Will Atkinson:

T: The Hexham Races
K: Gmaj
|:GBd gdB|ded d2B|GBd gdB|ABA AdB|
GBd gdB|def gfe|dcB cBA|1 GAG GdB:|2 GAG Gef||
|:g2d edB|ded def|g2d edB|ABA Aef|
g2d edB|def gfe|dcB cBA|1 GAG Gef:|2 GAG GdB||

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on March 29th, 2004.

Irish version

…is called “I Will If I Can” https://thesession.org/tunes/1595.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on July 11th, 2004.

Nice in D on the fiddle

I like to play this tune as a marchy jig in D on the fiddle, with the G string tuned up to A as a drone. I put a run from the open A up to the D on a single bowstroke at the start of the second part, to add to the Scottish flavour.

↳ Posted by Tim Brooks on February 21st, 2005.
